Persona

Identity surface: avatar, name, description, status. DIVERGES from the web original, which is a Rive animation — the animated avatar is not ported, so no consumer inherits a native animation runtime.

  • v0.2.1
  • component
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/persona.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/persona.json

Dependencies

No required npm packages — this item installs through the registry dependencies below.

https://reactnativereusables.com/r/nativewind/avatar.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/nativewind/text.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/uniwind/avatar.json
https://reactnativereusables.com/r/uniwind/text.json
